cohort: 50 pregnant women admitted to a hospital in Bangladesh, 29 with subclinical hypothyroidism and 21 with overt hypothyroidism.
finding: Overt hypothyroidism in Bangladeshi pregnant women was associated with more maternal complications and adverse perinatal outcomes compared to subclinical hypothyroidism.
mod_finding: The majority of patients in both the overt and subclinical hypothyroidism groups underwent cesarean section due to associated medical and obstetrical complications.
